hooks.name: Accessibility review on UI save
hooks.description: Every saved component is checked against the accessibility steering before the agent moves on.

action.prompt: A UI file was just saved. Check it against .kiro/steering/accessibility.md: is every visible state also spoken or announced, does every new control have a key and a visible focus ring, are decorative layers aria-hidden and stopped under prefers-reduced-motion, is body text Atkinson Hyperlegible at 18px or more, is colour never the only signal? Fix anything that fails before continuing.
